title: Issue #396 provider-gate closed contract family, version 1
$comment: Validate a payload against the named $defs entry. Every payload object is closed. x-key-order and x-array-order are normative extensions consumed by the canonical codec; JSON Schema properties order alone is not normative.

EvidencePath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path. Semantic validation also rejects an empty segment, a dot segment, an absolute path, NUL, backslash, symlink traversal, and duplicate paths.

x-hash-contract.manifest_core_sha256: SHA-256(ASCII(spec-dock.provider-gate.manifest-core.v1) || 0x00 || uint64_be(length(core_json)) || core_json), where core_json is canonical UTF-8 JSON plus exactly one terminal LF for fields 1 through 12
x-hash-contract.bundle_sha256: SHA-256(ASCII(spec-dock.provider-gate.bundle.v1) || 0x00 || raw32(manifest_core_sha256) || records), where wheel and sdist records are sorted by filename UTF-8 bytes and each record is uint64_be(name_length) || name_utf8 || uint64_be(metadata_length) || canonical_artifact_metadata_json || uint64_be(actual_length) || actual_artifact_bytes; metadata uses CandidateArtifactV1 field order
x-hash-contract.candidate_manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of the final distributed candidate-manifest.json UTF-8 bytes including its single terminal LF; it is recorded only outside CandidateManifestV1 and is not an input to manifest_core_sha256 or bundle_sha256

x-source-resolution.pull_request: source_sha is github.event.pull_request.head.sha and source_repository is github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name; raw GITHUB_SHA is the merge-branch SHA and is never candidate identity
x-source-resolution.workflow_dispatch: source_sha is a required workflow input named source_sha and pull_request_number is null; branch tip and raw GITHUB_SHA do not substitute for the input
x-source-resolution.merge_group: source_sha is the event's GITHUB_SHA, which GitHub defines as the merge-group SHA, and pull_request_number is null
x-source-resolution.all_events: source_tree is resolved from the exact source repository and source_sha; every role checks out that same SHA and verifies the same tree before test execution

EnvironmentFingerprintV1.x-fingerprint-contract: fingerprint_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical fields 1 through 19; null means not applicable or not collected, never an omitted field or a string placeholder. linux-canonical admission rejects null capability fields.

AttemptRegistrationV1.x-attempt-id-contract: attempt_id = SHA-256(domain-separated canonical tuple repository_id, workflow_id, workflow_run_id, run_attempt). run_attempt greater than one remains a rejected history member.

ProcessMetricsV1.x-acceptance-rule: Parent thresholds are evaluated from raw integer time and CPU fields using exact arithmetic. cpu_wall_ratio_decimal is display-only and never determines acceptance.

x-array-order.role_results: role order candidate-producer, static-analysis, linux-canonical, sdist-smoke, macos-delta

accepted requires complete identity and raw evidence
accepted requires every required role and parent predicate to pass
missing evidence is incomplete and never success

x-array-order.members: chronological created_at ascending, then numeric workflow_run_id ascending

x-semantic-invariants: member population is selected by generated E384-QUAL-001 policy
started failures, cancellation, interruption, and missing evidence remain members

expected_fault_ids is frozen before execution
executed_fault_ids equals expected_fault_ids for a complete result
detected_fault_ids union missed_fault_ids equals expected_fault_ids
accepted requires zero misses

failure/cancel/interruption/missing evidence remain members
